effects.text: causes minting less shares than expected
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.
evidence: In ve33/contracts/GovernanceHYBR.sol, `deposit()` locks the incoming HYBR into the veNFT first and then calculates gHYBR shares. `calculateShares` reads `totalAssets` after it already includes the new deposit. The effective formula becomes `shares = amount * totalSupply / (assets_before + amount)`. This inflates the denominator with the depositor’s own funds and causes minting less shares than expected.
